name: popover
behavior: APG disclosure / non-modal dialog pattern (trigger has aria-haspopup=dialog + aria-expanded; focus moves into panel but is NOT trapped; Esc and outside click dismiss and return focus to trigger)

parts.note: typically a button — anatomy delegated to anatomy/button.json

anatomyNotes: Salt's Overlay (header + close button + content) is this anatomy with the dialog header/close parts composed inside the panel content slot — composition, not different anatomy.
